name: Gays
overview: Scripture clearly identifies homosexual acts as sinful, describing them as an abomination and against the natural order, as seen in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13 and Romans 1:26. While God commands obedience to His law above human opinion (Acts 5:29), He also calls His people to avoid judgment of others (Matthew 7:1). Isaiah 56:3 reminds us that those who join themselves to the Lord are not excluded from His people, emphasizing God's inclusive grace despite human sinfulness. This study will also explore the subtopic of God's forgiveness toward those who repent from such sins.
